name: Yoshimura Sayuri
source:
The heroine who became one of the targets on the molester site. Her hobby is reading and she often goes to the library. At first glance, she looks like a bookworm, but she actually has a great delusional habit, and after being molested, she begins to change into a nymphomaniac.

[Edited from [url=https://www.debonosu.jp/euphoria/game/soy_rankaku/character.html]Official site[/url]]
